reason: I'm a solo freelancer running one agent at a time with no team to share sessions, skills, or credentials with, so the whole pitch solves nothing I have. As a deal hunter who lives on free tiers, $30/seat/month for team context-sharing I'd never use is an easy no.
objection: I work alone — there's no team or second agent to keep in sync, so paying for a shared layer between agents is paying for a problem I don't have.
